goals.text: Either package can be released from the same two workflows, each with its own version source and tag family, and only kmctl's release is Latest
Every release publishes the notes that were reviewed in its version pull request, listing only that package's commits since its family's previous tag

outcomes.change: kmaudit's version comes from a one-line VERSION file that hatchling reads
outcomes.checked_by: a test that `scripts/release.py --package kmaudit current` prints the VERSION file's value, that the file holds `0.1.0.dev0` and `release.py compare '' 0.1.0.dev0` prints `skip` (so the landing push releases nothing), and that the pyproject declares version dynamic with a regex source on that file; `uv lock --check` passes with no kmaudit version line

outcomes.change: The version and wheel scripts take `--package kmctl|kmaudit`
outcomes.checked_by: tests that next_release_version reads only `kmaudit-v*` tags for kmaudit and only `v*` for kmctl, that `release.py set --package kmaudit` writes only the VERSION file and pins the install line in `packages/kmaudit/README.md` to `kmaudit-vX.Y.Z`, that kmctl's `set`, `current` and `manifest` behave as today, that a new `release.py tag` verb prints the tag for a package and version, and that the smoke test runs `kmaudit --version` with no skills check for kmaudit

outcomes.change: release_notes.py drafts one package's notes for a tag not yet pushed, into a file
outcomes.checked_by: tests on a scratch git repo that `release_notes.py --package kmaudit kmaudit-v0.2.0 --ref HEAD --out FILE` writes notes for the range from the family's previous tag to HEAD when the tag does not exist, lists a commit touching `packages/kmaudit/` but not one touching only kmctl's paths (and the reverse for kmctl), never counts a `v*` tag as kmaudit's previous tag, skips `release/kmaudit-v` merges and `release: kmaudit-v` commits, and fills the kmaudit template's install line with `#subdirectory=packages/kmaudit`; existing tagged-tag tests still pass

outcomes.change: The Release run takes a package, drafts its notes to a file, and commits that file into the version pull request and its body with a Drafted-From trailer
outcomes.checked_by: workflow tests that the inputs are `package` (choice kmctl, kmaudit), increment, prerelease, version and dry_run; that resolve passes `--package` and checks the family's tag on origin; that build runs `uv build --package` for the chosen package and the per-package wheel checks; that a notes job, which runs in dry runs too, writes `release_notes.py` output to the notes file as its own step a later step can replace, shows it in the step summary and uploads it as an artifact; that bump needs that job, downloads the artifact, checks out the exact commit the draft was made from, opens `release/TAG` on it, stages the notes file with every file `release.py set` wrote, writes a `Drafted-From: <sha>` trailer in the commit message, and passes a body holding the notes file and the same trailer to `gh pr create --body-file`

outcomes.change: release-tag publishes the committed notes for whichever package's version rose, refuses without them, and marks only kmctl Latest
outcomes.checked_by: workflow tests that the push paths are `apm/apm.yml` and `packages/kmaudit/VERSION`; that the tag job runs once per package (matrix) comparing that package's version before and after; that the step refusing a missing or blank .github/release-notes/TAG.md runs before `git tag -a`; that `gh release create` uses `--notes-file` on that committed file with no call to `release_notes.py` and no `--generate-notes`; that kmctl passes `--latest` and kmaudit `--latest=false`; that a step finds the drafted commit as the parent of the merge's second parent for a two-parent merge, else from the `Drafted-From` trailer of the pushed commit, and, run in bash against a scratch repo, writes a `::warning::` and a step-summary section naming a package commit that landed between the drafted commit and the merge's first parent while the published notes file stays byte for byte the reviewed one; and that ADR 0012 carries a dated Correction naming the package input, the tag families, the VERSION file and the committed notes file, checked by `tests/scripts/test_release_docs.py`

problems.text: `scripts/next_release_version.py`, `scripts/release.py`, `scripts/check_wheel.py` and `scripts/smoke_wheel.py` know only kmctl: one `v*` tag family, one version source and kmctl's wheel checks, so nothing can work out, set or check a kmaudit release
kmaudit's version is a static literal in `packages/kmaudit/pyproject.toml` that `uv.lock` copies, so a bump edits two files and its trigger fires on every dependency edit
`scripts/release_notes.py` lists every commit since the previous `v*` tag whatever it touched, and refuses a tag that is not pushed yet, so it cannot draft one package's notes before the release
the Release run takes no package, writes no notes, and opens a version pull request whose body says nothing about what changed, so nobody reviews the notes before they ship
`.github/workflows/release-tag.yml` watches only `apm/apm.yml`, builds only kmctl, generates its own notes at publish time without refusing empty ones, and lets every Release become Latest
